question: Which weeks met the treatment-plan goal?
answer:
**Only the week of 2026-01-19 to 2026-01-25 met the treatment-plan goal.** The goal requires at least 3 therapy days and at least 150 minutes of patient-present therapy in each Monday–Sunday week. [BH-D003] “Local treatment participation goal: at least 3 therapy days and at least 150 minutes of patient-present therapy in each Monday–Sunday week. A therapy day is a calendar day on which Rowan participates in individual, group, or family psychotherapy.”

| Week | Therapy days | Therapy minutes | Verdict |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 2026-01-05 to 2026-01-11 | 3 | 140 | Not met — minutes below threshold |
| 2026-01-12 to 2026-01-18 | 2 | 120 | Not met — both thresholds below goal |
| **2026-01-19 to 2026-01-25** | **3** | **180** | **Met** |
| 2026-01-26 to 2026-02-01 | 3 | 145–155 | Indeterminate — partial week in the review period, and the minutes range straddles the threshold |

**Uncertainty:** The final week includes only 2026-01-26 to 2026-01-30 in the review period. For contact HG-M042/2026-01-26/HG-E115, the records conflict: [BH-D111] “The full patient-contact interval for the encounter was 09:10–09:50.” [BH-D110] “Actual patient psychotherapy contact: 09:00–09:50, 50 minutes.” The abstraction reports the week’s total as **145–155 minutes** and says an attestation or correction from the treating clinicians is needed to resolve it. A 2026-01-27 group was excluded because the final attendance register records: [BH-D108] “No show; patient did not attend” and “No patient treatment contact occurred.”
